# Datamining: "Call to Axe-ion" aka "Axtionism" challenges

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_26_nukaknights-post-axtionismus-challenges.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Dates: **15.11.-29.11.2022** "Axtionism" Challenge Event

The data miner Gears (DSJ) has discovered another interesting new challenge. This challenge is structured like the "Heart in Hand" and "Gathering Storm" Challenge. This means that you can complete these challenges with a specific item equipped over 14 days and receive a final reward at the end.

The challenge comes to us with the "The PITT" update in **September 2022** and is called "Call to Axe-ion" in English.

To take part you need the new **Auto-Axe** weapon with the **"Redd-Spalter" paint job** (which will be available for free in the Atom Shop / Discovered by dataminer SugarBombs.RADS). You must have these equipped to complete the challenges.

## Daily Challenges:

- 
 Kill 10 Trogs with the Redd Cleaver 
Reward: 1 legendary module
- 
 Kill 10 Fanatics with the Redd Cleaver 
Reward: Skill Card Pack
- 
 Kill 10 insects with the Redd Cleaver 
Reward: 1 lunch box
- 
 Kill 10 Super Mutants with the Redd Cleaver 
Reward: 1 Carrying Capacity Booster
- 
 Destroy 10 robots with the Redd-Upper 
Reward: 1 repair kit
